summary: Iteration 12 – Trading Only header copy + reactions emoji set. BACKEND (8/8 pytest passing at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_reactions.py against live preview API): logged in as demo@leveluphub.com / Trader123! and used the top post from GET /api/posts. POST /api/posts/{id}/react {reaction:'💜'} → 200 with my_reaction='💜' and liked=true; {reaction:'‼️'} → 200 with my_reaction='‼️'; {reaction:'🩷'} → 400 'Unknown reaction'; {reaction:'🗣️'} → 400 'Unknown reaction'; {reaction:null} → 200 my_reaction=null. POST /api/posts/{id}/like from a clean state → 200 my_reaction='💜'; second call → 200 my_reaction=null. Enumerated the reactions summary keys from GET /api/posts?limit=30 (main) and GET /api/posts?space=trading&limit=30 (trading) – no post's reactions dict contains 🩷 or 🗣️, confirming the legacy-emoji migration held. FRONTEND (Expo web 390x844, demo login): /trading mounts trading-only-screen; the header shows 'TRADING ONLY' on a single line beside the bar-chart mark, the tagline 'The conversation behind the charts.' is NOT present in the DOM anywhere (removed as required); the descriptive paragraph 'A members-only space for real conversations about strategies, prop firms, platforms, tools, trading psychology, resources, lessons learned and everything trading.' is still rendered under the header; trading-back-button, trading-compose-button, trading-search-button are all visible; tapping trading-back-button routes to /premium. Reaction control tested on THREE surfaces (main feed, Trading Only feed, post detail): tapping post-react-<id> opens reaction-picker with exactly the eight testIDs reaction-option-😂 / reaction-option-💜 / reaction-option-🤑 / reaction-option-🥳 / reaction-option-🔥 / reaction-option-‼️ / reaction-option-🤗 / reaction-option-🤬 in every case, and neither reaction-option-🩷 nor reaction-option-🗣️ exists. Picking 💜 updates post-my-reaction-<id> to '💜'; re-opening and picking ‼️ updates it to '‼️'; re-opening and pressing reaction-remove clears the reaction (post-my-reaction-<id> no longer rendered). All UI-side reactions added during the run were removed via reaction-remove; no seed posts modified.

Trading Only header no longer shows the tagline; reactions set is exactly 😂 💜 🤑 🥳 🔥 ‼️ 🤗 🤬 on backend and all three frontend surfaces (main feed, Trading Only, post detail); legacy 🩷 and 🗣️ are rejected with 400 and no live post carries them in its reaction summary.
